# PrivateAI for Mac

Canonical AI-readable product index: https://jacobjiangwei.github.io/PrivateAI-for-Mac/llms.txt

PrivateAI for Mac is an open-source native macOS AI agent powered by local Ollama models. It supports bounded local document analysis, supervised non-interactive terminal work, native Mac context, and screenshot-driven browser computer use.

Repository: https://github.com/jacobjiangwei/PrivateAI-for-Mac
Website: https://jacobjiangwei.github.io/PrivateAI-for-Mac/
Latest release: https://github.com/jacobjiangwei/PrivateAI-for-Mac/releases/latest
